1.english_reference: And the rulers of the people dwelt at Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּשְׁב֥וּ שָׂרֵֽי הָ עָ֖ם בִּ ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐκάθισαν οἱ ἄρχοντες τοῦ λαοῦ ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ ·
traditions.VUL: Habitavérunt autem príncipes pópuli in Ierúsalem :
traditions.KJV: And the rulers of the people dwelt at Jerusalem :

1.english_reference: the rest of the people also cast lots

traditions.WLC: וּ שְׁאָ֣ר הָ֠ עָם הִפִּ֨ילוּ גוֹרָל֜וֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἱ κατάλοιποι τοῦ λαοῦ ἐλάβοσαν κλήρους
traditions.VUL: réliqua vero plebs misit sortem ,
traditions.KJV: the rest of the people also cast lots ,

1.english_reference: to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: לְ הָבִ֣יא אֶחָ֣ד מִן הָ עֲשָׂרָ֗ה לָ שֶׁ֨בֶת֙ בִּֽ ירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙
traditions.LXX: ἐνέγκαι ἕνα ἀπὸ τῶν δέκα καθίσαι ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ ,
traditions.VUL: ut tóllerent unam partem de decem , qui habitatúri essent in Ierúsalem
traditions.KJV: to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: עִ֣יר הַ קֹּ֔דֶשׁ
traditions.LXX: πόλει τῇ ἁγίᾳ ,
traditions.VUL: civitáte sancta ,
traditions.KJV: the holy city ,

1.english_reference: and nine parts [ to dwell ] in [ other ] cities

traditions.WLC: וְ תֵ֥שַׁע הַ יָּד֖וֹת בֶּ עָרִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐννέα μέρη ἐν ταῖς πόλεσιν .
traditions.VUL: novem vero partes in civitátibus .
traditions.KJV: and nine parts [ to dwell ] in [ other ] cities .

2.english_reference: And the people blessed all the men , that willingly offered themselves to dwell at Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יְבָרֲכ֖וּ הָ עָ֑ם לְ כֹל֙ הָֽ אֲנָשִׁ֔ים הַ מִּֽתְנַדְּבִ֔ים לָ שֶׁ֖בֶת בִּ ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ εὐλόγησεν ὁ λαὸς τοὺς πάντας ἄνδρας τοὺς ἑκουσιαζομένους καθίσαι ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ .
traditions.VUL: Benedíxit autem pópulus ómnibus viris , qui se sponte obtúlerant ut habitárent in Ierúsalem .
traditions.KJV: And the people blessed all the men , that willingly offered themselves to dwell at Jerusalem .

3.english_reference: Now these [ are ] the chief of the province that dwelt in Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וְ אֵ֨לֶּה֙ רָאשֵׁ֣י הַ מְּדִינָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָשְׁב֖וּ בִּ ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὗτοι οἱ ἄρχοντες τῆς χώρας οἳ ἐκάθισαν ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ ·
traditions.VUL: Hi sunt ítaque príncipes provínciæ , qui habitavérunt in Ierúsalem ,
traditions.KJV: Now these [ are ] the chief of the province that dwelt in Jerusalem :

3.english_reference: but in the cities of Judah dwelt every one in his possession in their cities

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה יָֽשְׁב֞וּ אִ֤ישׁ בַּ אֲחֻזָּת וֹ֙ בְּ עָ֣רֵי הֶ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν πόλεσιν Ἰούδα ἐκάθισεν ἀνὴρ ἐν κατασχέσει αὐτοῦ ἐν πόλεσιν αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: et in civitátibus Iuda . Habitávit autem unusquísque in possessióne sua , in úrbibus suis ,
traditions.KJV: but in the cities of Judah dwelt every one in his possession in their cities , [ to wit ] ,

3.english_reference: Israel , the priests , and the Levites , and the Nethinims , and the children of Solomon ’s servants

traditions.WLC: יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל הַ כֹּהֲנִים֙ וְ הַ לְוִיִּ֣ם וְ הַ נְּתִינִ֔ים וּ בְנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֥י שְׁלֹמֹֽה
traditions.LXX: Ἰσραήλ , οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ οἱ Λευεῖται καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ δούλων Σαλωμών .
traditions.VUL: Israel , sacerdótes , Levítæ , Nathinǽi , et fílii servórum Salomónis .
traditions.KJV: Israel , the priests , and the Levites , and the Nethinims , and the children of Solomon ’s servants .

4.english_reference: And at Jerusalem dwelt [ certain ] of the children of Judah , and of the children of Benjamin

traditions.WLC: וּ בִֽ ירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ יָֽשְׁב֔וּ מִ בְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה וּ מִ בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν Ἰερουσαλὴμ ἐκάθισαν ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ἰούδα καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Βενιαμείν .
traditions.VUL: Et in Ierúsalem habitavérunt de fíliis Iuda , et de fíliis Béniamin :
traditions.KJV: And at Jerusalem dwelt [ certain ] of the children of Judah , and of the children of Benjamin .

4.english_reference: Of the children of Judah ; Athaiah the son of Uzziah , the son of Zechariah , the son of Amariah , the son of Shephatiah , the son of Mahalaleel , of the children of Perez

traditions.WLC: מִ בְּנֵ֣י יְ֠הוּדָה עֲתָיָ֨ה בֶן עֻזִּיָּ֜ה בֶּן זְכַרְיָ֧ה בֶן אֲמַרְיָ֛ה בֶּן שְׁפַטְיָ֥ה בֶן מַהֲלַלְאֵ֖ל מִ בְּנֵי פָֽרֶץ
traditions.LXX: ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ἰούδα · Ἀθεὰ υἱὸς Ἀζὲδ υἱὸς Ζαχαριὰ υἱὸς Σαμαρειὰ υἱὸς Σαφατιὰ υἱὸς Μαλελήμ , καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Φάρες .
traditions.VUL: de fíliis Iuda , Athaías fílius Azíam , fílii Zacharíæ , fílii Amaríæ , fílii Saphatíæ , fílii Maláleel : de fíliis Phares ,
traditions.KJV: Of the children of Judah ; Athaiah the son of Uzziah , the son of Zechariah , the son of Amariah , the son of Shephatiah , the son of Mahalaleel , of the children of Perez ;

5.english_reference: And Maaseiah the son of Baruch , the son of Colhozeh , the son of Hazaiah , the son of Adaiah , the son of Joiarib , the son of Zechariah , the son of Shiloni

traditions.WLC: וּ מַעֲשֵׂיָ֣ה בֶן בָּר֣וּךְ בֶּן כָּל חֹ֠זֶה בֶּן חֲזָיָ֨ה בֶן עֲדָיָ֧ה בֶן יוֹיָרִ֛יב בֶּן זְכַרְיָ֖ה בֶּן הַ שִּׁלֹנִֽי
traditions.LXX: καὶ Μαασειὰ υἱὸς Βαροὺχ υἱὸς Χαλεὰ υἱὸς Ὁζειὰ υἱὸς Δαλεὰ υἱὸς Ἰωρεὶβ υἱὸς Θηζειὰ υἱὸς τοῦ Δηλωνέ .
traditions.VUL: Maasía fílius Baruch , fílius Cholhóza , fílius Hazía , fílius Adaía , fílius Ióiarib , fílius Zacharíæ , fílius Silonítis :
traditions.KJV: And Maaseiah the son of Baruch , the son of Colhozeh , the son of Hazaiah , the son of Adaiah , the son of Joiarib , the son of Zechariah , the son of Shiloni .

6.english_reference: All the sons of Perez that dwelt at Jerusalem [ were ] four hundred threescore and eight valiant men

traditions.WLC: כָּל בְּנֵי פֶ֕רֶץ הַ יֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בִּ ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֛וֹת שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וּ שְׁמֹנָ֖ה אַנְשֵׁי חָֽיִל
traditions.LXX: πάντες υἱοὶ Σέρες οἱ καθήμενοι ἐν Ἰερουσαλὴμ τετρακόσιοι ἑξήκοντα ὀκτὼ ἄνδρες δυνάμεως .
traditions.VUL: omnes hi fílii Phares , qui habitavérunt in Ierúsalem , quadringénti sexagínta octo viri fortes .
traditions.KJV: All the sons of Perez that dwelt at Jerusalem [ were ] four hundred threescore and eight valiant men .

7.english_reference: And these [ are ] the sons of Benjamin ; Sallu the son of Meshullam , the son of Joed , the son of Pedaiah , the son of Kolaiah , the son of Maaseiah , the son of Ithiel , the son of Jesaiah

traditions.WLC: וְ אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן סַלֻּ֡א בֶּן מְשֻׁלָּ֡ם בֶּן יוֹעֵ֡ד בֶּן פְּדָיָה֩ בֶן ק֨וֹלָיָ֧ה בֶן מַעֲשֵׂיָ֛ה בֶּן אִֽיתִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן יְשַֽׁעְיָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὗτοι υἱοὶ Βενιαμείν · Σηλὼ υἱὸς Ἀμεσουλά , Ἰωὰδ υἱὸς Φαλαιὰ υἱὸς Κοδιὰ υἱὸς Μαγαὴλ υἱὸς Αἰθιὴλ υἱὸς Ἰεσιά ·
traditions.VUL: Hi sunt autem fílii Béniamin : Sellum fílius Mosóllam , fílius Ioed , fílius Phadaía , fílius Colaía , fílius Masía , fílius Etheel , fílius Isaía ,
traditions.KJV: And these [ are ] the sons of Benjamin ; Sallu the son of Meshullam , the son of Joed , the son of Pedaiah , the son of Kolaiah , the son of Maaseiah , the son of Ithiel , the son of Jesaiah .

8.english_reference: And after him Gabbai , Sallai , nine hundred twenty and eight

traditions.WLC: וְ אַחֲרָ֖י ו גַּבַּ֣י סַלָּ֑י תְּשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּ שְׁמֹנָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ Γηβή , Σηλεί , ἐννακόσιοι εἴκοσι ὀκτώ .
traditions.VUL: et post eum Gébbai , Séllai , nongénti vigínti octo ,
traditions.KJV: And after him Gabbai , Sallai , nine hundred twenty and eight .

9.english_reference: And Joel the son of Zichri [ was ] their overseer

traditions.WLC: וְ יוֹאֵ֥ל בֶּן זִכְרִ֖י פָּקִ֣יד עֲלֵי הֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ Ἰωὴλ υἱὸς Ζεχρεὶ ἐπίσκοπος ἐπ᾽ αὐτούς ,
traditions.VUL: et Ioel fílius Zechri præpósitus eórum ,
traditions.KJV: And Joel the son of Zichri [ was ] their overseer :

9.english_reference: and Judah the son of Senuah [ was ] second over the city

traditions.WLC: וִ יהוּדָ֧ה בֶן הַ סְּנוּאָ֛ה עַל הָ עִ֖יר מִשְׁנֶֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ Ἰούδας υἱὸς Ἁσανὰ ἐπὶ τῆς πόλεως δεύτερος .
traditions.VUL: et Iudas fílius Sénua super civitátem secúndus .
traditions.KJV: and Judah the son of Senuah [ was ] second over the city .

10.english_reference: Of the priests : Jedaiah the son of Joiarib , Jachin

traditions.WLC: מִן הַֽ כֹּהֲנִ֑ים יְדַֽעְיָ֥ה בֶן יוֹיָרִ֖יב יָכִֽין
traditions.LXX: ἀπὸ τῶν ἱερέων καὶ Δαδειὰ υἱὸς Ἰωρείβ , Ἰαχείν ,
traditions.VUL: Et de sacerdótibus , Idaía fílius Ióarib , Iachin ,
traditions.KJV: Of the priests : Jedaiah the son of Joiarib , Jachin .

11.english_reference: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah , the son of Meshullam , the son of Zadok , the son of Meraioth , the son of Ahitub , [ was ] the ruler of the house of God .

traditions.WLC: שְׂרָיָ֨ה בֶן חִלְקִיָּ֜ה בֶּן מְשֻׁלָּ֣ם בֶּן צָד֗וֹק בֶּן מְרָיוֹת֙ בֶּן אֲחִיט֔וּב נְגִ֖ד בֵּ֥ית הָ אֱלֹהִֽים
traditions.LXX: Σαραιὰ υἱὸς Ἑλκειὰ υἱὸς Μεισουλὰμ υἱὸς Σαδδοὺκ υἱὸς Μαριὼθ υἱὸς Ἀπωβώχ , ἀπέναντι οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ .
traditions.VUL: Saraía fílius Helcíæ , fílius Mosóllam , fílius Sadoc , fílius Méraioth , fílius Achitob princeps domus Dei ,
traditions.KJV: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah , the son of Meshullam , the son of Zadok , the son of Meraioth , the son of Ahitub , [ was ] the ruler of the house of God .

12.english_reference: And their brethren that did the work of the house [ were ] eight hundred twenty and two :

traditions.WLC: וַ אֲחֵי הֶ֗ם עֹשֵׂ֤י הַ מְּלָאכָה֙ לַ בַּ֔יִת שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֣ים וּ שְׁנָ֑יִם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῶν ποιοῦντες τὸ ἔργον τοῦ οἴκου ·
traditions.VUL: et fratres eórum faciéntes ópera templi : octingénti vigínti duo .
traditions.KJV: And their brethren that did the work of the house [ were ] eight hundred twenty and two :

12.english_reference: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham , the son of Pelaliah , the son of Amzi , the son of Zechariah , the son of Pashur , the son of Malchiah ,

traditions.WLC: וַ֠ עֲדָיָה בֶּן יְרֹחָ֤ם בֶּן פְּלַלְיָה֙ בֶּן אַמְצִ֣י בֶן זְכַרְיָ֔ה בֶּן פַּשְׁח֖וּר בֶּן מַלְכִּיָּֽה
traditions.LXX: Ἀμασεὶ υἱὸς Ζαχαρειὰ υἱὸς Φασσοὺρ υἱὸς Μελχειά ,

traditions.KJV: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham , the son of Pelaliah , the son of Amzi , the son of Zechariah , the son of Pashur , the son of Malchiah ,

13.english_reference: And his brethren , chief of the fathers , two hundred forty and two :

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶחָי ו֙ רָאשִׁ֣ים לְ אָב֔וֹת מָאתַ֖יִם אַרְבָּעִ֣ים וּ שְׁנָ֑יִם
traditions.LXX: ἄρχοντες πατριῶν διακόσιοι τεσσεράκοντα δύο .
traditions.VUL: et fratres eius príncipes patrum : ducénti quadragínta duo .
traditions.KJV: And his brethren , chief of the fathers , two hundred forty and two :

13.english_reference: and Amashai the son of Azareel , the son of Ahasai , the son of Meshillemoth , the son of Immer ,

traditions.WLC: וַ עֲמַשְׁסַ֧י בֶּן עֲזַרְאֵ֛ל בֶּן אַחְזַ֥י בֶּן מְשִׁלֵּמ֖וֹת בֶּן אִמֵּֽר
traditions.LXX: καὶ Ἀμασειὰ υἱὸς Ἐσδριήλ ,
traditions.VUL: Et Amássai fílius Azreel , fílius Aházi , fílius Mosóllamoth , fílius Emmer ,
traditions.KJV: and Amashai the son of Azareel , the son of Ahasai , the son of Meshillemoth , the son of Immer ,

14.english_reference: And their brethren , mighty men of valour , an hundred twenty and eight :

traditions.WLC: וַ אֲחֵי הֶם֙ גִּבּ֣וֹרֵי חַ֔יִל מֵאָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֣ים וּ שְׁמֹנָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ δυνατοὶ παρατάξεως ἑκατὸν εἴκοσι ὀκτώ ,
traditions.VUL: et fratres eórum poténtes nimis : centum vigínti octo ,
traditions.KJV: And their brethren , mighty men of valour , an hundred twenty and eight :

14.english_reference: and their overseer [ was ] Zabdiel , the son of [ one of ] the great men .

traditions.WLC: וּ פָקִ֣יד עֲלֵי הֶ֔ם זַבְדִּיאֵ֖ל בֶּן הַ גְּדוֹלִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπίσκοπος Βαδιήλ .
traditions.VUL: et præpósitus eórum Zábdiel fílius poténtium .
traditions.KJV: and their overseer [ was ] Zabdiel , the son of [ one of ] the great men .

15.english_reference: Also of the Levites : Shemaiah the son of Hashub , the son of Azrikam , the son of Hashabiah , the son of Bunni ;

traditions.WLC: וּ מִֽן הַ לְוִיִּ֑ם שְׁמַעְיָ֧ה בֶן חַשּׁ֛וּב בֶּן עַזְרִיקָ֥ם בֶּן חֲשַׁבְיָ֖ה בֶּן בּוּנִּֽי
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν Λευειτῶν Σαμαιὰ υἱὸς Ἁσοὺβ υἱὸς Ἐζερεί ·
traditions.VUL: Et de Levítis , Semeía fílius Hasub , fílius Azarícam , fílius Hasabía , fílius Boni ,
traditions.KJV: Also of the Levites : Shemaiah the son of Hashub , the son of Azrikam , the son of Hashabiah , the son of Bunni ;

16.english_reference: And Shabbethai and Jozabad , of the chief of the Levites , [ had ] the oversight of the outward business of the house of God .

traditions.WLC: וְ שַׁבְּתַ֨י וְ יוֹזָבָ֜ד עַל הַ מְּלָאכָ֤ה הַ חִֽיצֹנָה֙ לְ בֵ֣ית הָ אֱלֹהִ֔ים מֵ רָאשֵׁ֖י הַ לְוִיִּֽם
traditions.VUL: et Sabáthai et Iózabed , super ómnia ópera , quæ erant forínsecus in domo Dei , a princípibus Levitárum .
traditions.KJV: And Shabbethai and Jozabad , of the chief of the Levites , [ had ] the oversight of the outward business of the house of God .

17.english_reference: And Mattaniah the son of Micha , the son of Zabdi , the son of Asaph , [ was ] the principal to begin the thanksgiving in prayer :

traditions.WLC: וּ מַתַּנְיָ֣ה בֶן מִ֠יכָה בֶּן זַבְדִּ֨י בֶן אָסָ֜ף רֹ֗אשׁ הַ תְּחִלָּה֙ יְהוֹדֶ֣ה לַ תְּפִלָּ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ Μαθανιὰ υἱὸς Μαχά ,
traditions.VUL: Et Mathanía fílius Micha , fílius Zebédei , fílius Asaph , princeps ad laudándum , et ad confiténdum in oratióne ,
traditions.KJV: And Mattaniah the son of Micha , the son of Zabdi , the son of Asaph , [ was ] the principal to begin the thanksgiving in prayer :

17.english_reference: and Bakbukiah the second among his brethren ,

traditions.WLC: וּ בַקְבֻּקְיָ֖ה מִשְׁנֶ֣ה מֵ אֶחָ֑י
traditions.VUL: et Becbecía secúndus de frátribus eius ,
traditions.KJV: and Bakbukiah the second among his brethren ,

17.english_reference: and Abda the son of Shammua , the son of Galal , the son of Jeduthun .

traditions.WLC: ו וְ עַבְדָּא֙ בֶּן שַׁמּ֔וּעַ בֶּן גָּלָ֖ל בֶּן ידיתון
traditions.LXX: καὶ Ὠβὴβ υἱὸς Σαμουεί ,
traditions.VUL: et Abda fílius Sámua , fílius Galal , fílius Idithum :
